ohCatalog: Efforts or costs that do not directly contribute to the modification or qualification of a required project delivery or task, including team meetings, team management, team-building activities, and so on.

When the support required from EC is an assessment of the EC's own effort, which may sometimes require an analysis of scope, deliverables, and delivery model and team proposals, it is then considered part of the EC's Engagement effort and is not typically charged to the region. It is understood that conducting these assessments is part of EC's job to ensure a healthy engagement.
Technical training, including technical software training, technical mentorship, discipline-specific training, and hard skills courses.
Training focused on getting skills for a specific project, where it is not possible to charge this effort to the project.
Digital CAD & MOD software training, courses, etc.
Mandatory onboarding training - excluding those related to quality- and soft skills training.
All quality-related training, except the ones related to specific projects, where the training is charged to the project.
Graduate program booked hours, that is, hours dedicated by these fresh professionals until they can be involved in projects.
Project Management, Design Management, or Project Controls support efforts that cannot be billed to the project.
Task to be used for SH&E (Safety, Health and Environment) initiatives.

Downtime or idle time. Efforts where the professional is either waiting to be involved in a project, or waiting between project stages, or some external factor is not allowing the employees to work. Not a productive time.
Time wasted due to hardware issues, such as a broken computer or waiting for a new one to arrive.
